name: @dialstack/sdk-server
description: Node.js server client for the DialStack SDK — REST API, webhooks and media streams
author: DialStack
//main: Legacy entry points for resolvers that ignore `exports` — bundlers configured with exportsFields: [], older tooling, and anything reading the manifest directly. origin/main shipped both; the split dropped them and `resolve.sync` then failed outright rather than falling back.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

//devDependencies: @dialstack/sdk-js is dev-only and type-only. This package names it in `import type` for the button and device shapes it shares with the browser SDK — the documented wire contract, which must not fork into two copies that drift. Those imports erase at build time, so nothing in dist/*.js references it and it is neither a dependency nor a peer. The declaration build inlines the type bodies, so a consumer installing only this package still resolves them.
//dependencies: None. A Node REST client has no business installing a browser softphone: the only thing it needed from @dialstack/sdk-webrtc was the ~60-line auto-pagination helper, now duplicated as src/pagination.ts. Two copies of pure interfaces plus one factory cannot skew, whereas the dependency edge made `npm ls` show a backend pulling in WebRTC.
